analysis:
Alright, it's March 24th, 2026, and Brandon Lang is here to lay down some cold, hard cash on the hardwood. NCAA lines are out, and I've got my eye on a couple of plays that scream 'money in the bank.'

For my LOCK of the day, we're heading to 'The Pit' in Albuquerque. You gotta respect a team that dominates at home, especially when they've got the altitude working in their favor. **New Mexico Lobos (-10.5)** against Saint Joseph's is a no-brainer. The Mountain West is playing tough this season, and the Lobos are consistently a physical, high-energy squad at home. Saint Joseph's, bless their hearts, just won't be able to handle the pressure, the pace, or the sheer athleticism of the Lobos on their home court. This isn't just a win; it's a statement, and New Mexico covers that 10.5 with ease.

Now, for my VALUE play, we're looking at a team that can put up points in bunches, getting a generous spread on the road. I'm rolling with the **Alabama Crimson Tide (9.5)** against Michigan. Look, Michigan is solid at home, I get it. But Nick Saban's Crimson Tide in basketball? They don't back down. This Alabama team is built on speed, transition offense, and the ability to hit from anywhere on the floor. Getting 9.5 points against a Michigan team that, while good, isn't exactly lighting the world on fire with blowouts, is just too much value to pass up. Alabama can score with anyone, and they'll keep this game tight enough to cover that spread, if not pull off the outright upset. Don't overthink it, fade the public and grab those points.
